name: What features can I add to an elevated deck?

mainEntity.name: What features can I add to an elevated deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can customize an elevated deck with various features to enhance its functionality and aesthetics. Popular additions include built-in seating, planters, privacy screens, custom lighting, pergolas, and outdoor kitchens. The choice of features can significantly impact the overall cost and complexity of the project, so it's a practical tradeoff between desired amenities and your budget.
